decision_rules.source_policy: Direct primary sources only: provider pages, author-official repositories, original papers/proceedings.
decision_rules.size_policy: Users, items, and interactions are populated only when an official provider, original paper, or author-official repository states them.
decision_rules.hash_policy: A provider checksum, immutable repository commit, release asset digest, or an E4 acquisition SHA-256 is required before bytes are executable.
decision_rules.rights_policy: Dataset rights are not inferred from a repository code license. Research use, commercial use, redistribution, derivative artifacts, and model-output rights are separate.
decision_rules.comparison_policy: Raw metrics across different datasets, filters, splits, or candidate policies are not directly comparable.
decision_rules.vietnamese_policy: Vietnamese language is an audit dimension, not evidence of task, split, rights, basket, history, or cold-item compatibility.
